newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms seek 21,500T of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have joinlty invited tenders to buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat on Friday, traders said on Thursday.
Of the total, Cheiljedang would buy 8,500 tonnes at basis prices over September futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, they said.
Dongah Flour would seek the remaining 13,000 tonnes at fixed prices.
Shipment was set for July 20-August 20 to the southeastern port of Pusan.
